Every student gets separate 20 sessions on both having short and long routes, including real bumper-to-bumper traffic. Just follow their instructions—they know exactly what they’re doing.

If Patil Sir raises his voice, it simply means you’re repeating a mistake. Take it positively and work on it. Uday Sir, on the other hand, teaches in a very calm and polite manner, which also helps build confidence.

They don’t just teach you how to drive—they help you become confident and responsible behind the wheel. Also, please try to attend the Saturday morning theory classes. Theory is important, and it’s difficult to cover during practical driving sessions.

I’m very satisfied with PP Training Motor School and would definitely recommend it to new learners.

Happy learning!
